function.name: list_files
function.description: List files (with line counts) under a directory. Use 'c_src' for the original C project, 'rust_spec' for the benchmark interface/tests as shipped, or a crate-relative path such as '.' or 'src' for the Rust crate you are writing.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file. Output lines are prefixed with 'NNNNN| ' line numbers which are NOT part of the file. Paths: 'c_src/...', 'rust_spec/...', or crate-relative like 'src/lib.rs'.

function.name: search
function.description: Regex search (Python syntax) over files under a path; returns 'path:line: text' matches. Useful to find where a C function, macro or struct is defined or used.

path.description: File or directory, default '.' (the crate). Use 'c_src' to search the C project.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or completely overwrite a Rust source file under src/ of the crate (e.g. 'src/satc.rs'). Benchmark tests (src/bin/*), Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are protected. For very large files, write the first part here and continue with append_file.

function.name: append_file
function.description: Append text to the end of a Rust source file under src/ (use to write large files in several chunks).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace an exact text snippet in a Rust source file. old_string must match the file exactly (including indentation, without the read_file line-number prefix) and be unique unless replace_all is true. Preferred for small repairs.

function.name: cargo_check
function.description: Run `cargo +nightly-2025-05-13 check --all-targets` (type-checks the library, binaries and the benchmark tests). Returns compiler errors (with codes and spans) or the warnings in your files.

reason.description: Optional: why you are running this now (logged in the trajectory)

function.name: cargo_build
function.description: Run `cargo +nightly-2025-05-13 build` exactly as the graders do.

reason.description: Optional: why you are running this now (logged in the trajectory)

function.name: cargo_test
function.description: Run `cargo +nightly-2025-05-13 test --no-fail-fast` (optionally filtered by a test name). Reports pass/fail for every benchmark test plus the panic messages / assertion diffs of failing tests.

function.name: cargo_clippy
function.description: Run `cargo +nightly-2025-05-13 clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -W clippy::correctness -W clippy::style -W clippy::complexity -W clippy::perf` (the grading command). Lists Clippy and rustc warnings in your files; warnings inside protected test files are only counted.

reason.description: Optional: why you are running this now (logged in the trajectory)

function.name: unsafe_metrics
function.description: Run the course's unsafe-metrics tool (cargo newmetrics): unsafe lines, unsafe calls, unsafe casts, pointer arithmetic, raw pointer dereferences/declarations, plus a lexical scan locating unsafe/raw-pointer/FFI code in your files. Target: all primary metrics 0.

reason.description: Optional: why you are running this now (logged in the trajectory)

function.name: check_interface
function.description: Check that every public function, struct (fields, derives), enum (variants) and const of the benchmark interface exists in your modules with the exact required signature, and list remaining unimplemented!/todo! calls.

reason.description: Optional: why you are running this now (logged in the trajectory)

function.name: finish
function.description: End this iteration when you believe the translation compiles, passes the tests and is safe and idiomatic (or you cannot make further progress). The controller then runs a full verification and may start another repair iteration with its feedback.

summary.description: What you changed in this iteration, what is still failing, and what you would try next
